moments.title: George Washington Birthplace National Monument
moments.text: Where Popes Creek meets the Potomac, the house Washington was born in was lost to fire on Christmas Day 1779, and crushed oyster shells now outline his boyhood home's foundation.

moments.title: Westmoreland State Park
moments.text: A trail runs down to the Potomac below the Horsehead Cliffs, which hold fossils of porpoises, whales and sharks from as long as 15 million years ago.

moments.title: Montross
moments.text: At the old courthouse here in June 1774, a meeting adopted Richard Henry Lee's resolution to send aid to blockaded Boston.
